tools.name: search_launches
tools.description: Search the TGE Index catalog of upcoming and recent token launches (TGEs). Every project is checked against its own official sources and scored on 8 disclosures (tokenomics, unlock schedule, float at TGE, market maker, venues, team or entity, audit, open incidents). Returns short records with the pr

tools.name: get_launch
tools.description: Full TGE Index profile of one project: launch date or official window, all 8 checks with notes and source links, official contract addresses (only from the project's own posts or filings), airdrop status, and the dated history of changes.

tools.name: launch_calendar
tools.description: Token launches for one month from the TGE Index catalog: launched, scheduled for a day, and those with only an official month or quarter window. Dates come from official sources only.

tools.name: recent_changes
tools.description: Dated changes across the TGE Index catalog, newest first: new projects, launches, moved or missed dates, score changes, each with its source.
